summary.text: H. Kevin Anderson, a Republican, represents District 38A (Somerset, Worcester and Wicomico Counties) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Environment and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Anderson was born in 1967 and attended Washington High School in Princess Anne and McDonogh School in Owings Mills, Maryland.
Anderson earned an A.A. in agriculture production and management from the University of Maryland, College Park.
The legislature's biography lists Anderson as owner and operator of Wimberly Farms in Somerset County, and says Anderson is married with two children.
